song: Lady (Hear Me Tonight) / I Don’t Like [Laurenzo Fab Remix] [Mixed]
line: Lady, hear me tonight ’Cause my feeling is just so right As we dance by the moonlight
meaning:
The beautiful evening he finds himself having leads him to reflect upon how he feels about the lady who means everything to him – the situation the two find themselves in makes everything seem right. Judging by her reaction, the feeling appears to be reciprocal, as he feels the same love emanating from her.

(Cited from Jtsar & HelloThereThom)

meaning:
